The figure shown as income tax is the full 'loonheffing' (income tax + national insurance combined); employee_contributions is 0 by construction, not because no social insurance is paid.

reference_profile_description: Standard employee, outside Scotland (rUK income-tax bands), full-time, standard tax code, auto-enrolled in a workplace pension at the statutory minimum rates.
note: Employee/employer contributions include Class 1 National Insurance and the statutory-minimum automatic-enrolment workplace pension (employee 5%, employer 3% of qualifying earnings), not income tax alone. rUK income-tax bands only; Scotland's devolved bands are not modelled.

reference_profile_description: Non-executive employee, outside Alsace-Moselle, firm with fewer than 50 employees, standard AT/MP rate, full-time. Income tax: single, childless taxpayer (1 part), progressive bareme.
